data.narrative:
Focused Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Thomas Forner and Markus Roth that has raised $240M to date. The valuation analysis considers a comp universe of 11 private and 3 public nuclear energy firms, including same-stage and adjacent-stage peers such as Fuse Energy ($200M Series A), Nano Nuclear Energy ($808M Seed), and Valar Atomics ($6.0B Series B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis assumes a 2.0x step-up multiplier from the $240M total raised proxy, implying a $480M valuation consistent with Series A advancement. Peer-median analysis across the three comparable companies yields $808M, reflecting the broad range of the nuclear sector ($200M–$6.0B) but anchoring to the median of available same-sector reference points.

Synthesizing both methods produces a valuation range of $408M (low) to $929M (high), with a median estimate of $644M. The wide dispersion in peer valuations—driven by stage heterogeneity (Seed through Series B) and sector maturation dynamics—introduces material uncertainty. The peer-median method is sensitive to the small sample size and stage mix. Stage-progression relies on the $240M raised as a proxy for enterprise value, which may not fully capture differentiation. Key downside risks include technical execution and regulatory pathway clarity; upside hinges on capital efficiency relative to later-stage peers like Valar Atomics.
